preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of nodes N in each test case must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] < i for i in range(1, N))
preconditions.description: Each parent node p_i must be a valid node number less than the current node i.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of subtree MEX values for each test case.
